name: Krasnodar-Krymsk Gas Pipeline
monitor_reason: length: no sourced length (>=25 km rule). Also no concrete step for a new row (federal-plan reconstruction listing only) and the line is an existing operating trunk, not a new build.
researcher_notes: Real operating Gazprom Transgaz Krasnodar main gas pipeline 'Krasnodar - Krymsk' (Krasnodar-Krymsk, Krasnodar Krai), NOT a roster duplicate: no roster row covers it (P1470/P5551 are Krasnodar Krai-Serpukhov; P0743 is Dzhubga-Sochi; P2425/P2426 are South European). Evidence: (1) Gov decree 816-r (06.05.2015) annex 4 item 199 (sudact.ru, verified): reconstruction of a section of main gas pipeline 'Krasnodar - Krymsk', Seversky district (Azovskoe and Severskoe rural settlements), 0.27 bcm/y, supplying Ilsky refinery; this is a section capacity, not system capacity. (2) bbgl.ru/news/24327 (verified loads): Ilsky refinery tie-in branch (219 mm, 5.4 MPa) taps 'the existing main gas pipeline Krasnodar - Krymsk (diameter 500 mm, pressure 5.4 MPa)'. (3) Search-result snippet (not fetched; energybase.ru page behind bot wall, Gazprom site unreachable): a Gazprom Transgaz Krasnodar tender for repair of the Vtoraya river crossing at km 87.49 'Krasnodar-Krymsk gas pipeline, Anapa LPUMG', which implies a length of at least ~88 km, but that is an inference, not a sourced length, so not used. No start year, no owner ref beyond operator inference (Gazprom Transgaz Krasnodar; entity not checked beyond lookup). Not a new proposal; the 816-r listing is a 2015 plan item, outside the 3-year window; qualifies only as an operating-never-captured line if a sourced length (likely ~90-100 km, Krasnodar to Krymsk) is found, e.g. a Gazprom Transgaz Krasnodar page or energybase.ru card. Recommend re-vet only if a length source surfaces. Route not researched.
